glyph_origin: Pictogram (象形) - two wings facing opposite directions. Originally, it represented wings; then, according to Xu Shen, its meaning changed into "leave; disobey" (違). Eventually, it was used perhaps as a phonetic loan to mean "not to be". Unrelated to the Kangxi radical 韭.
senses: [fēi] to run counter to; to not conform to
